_: The ladder for every world that has no generator of its own: how many posts and events a world has, and how many comments a post has, is brought up to a rung of `ladder` (16, 32, 64, 128, 256). app/phiegg/scripts/ladder.py reads this, after threads.mjs and city-life.py. Every record it adds carries origin `ladder` and a rerun replaces exactly those; records already there are never changed. Everything is fictional.
_rule: `fit` brings a count up to the lowest rung that holds what is there (9 posts become 16, 20 become 32). `spread` also draws a rung for each record from `spread` (six in sixteen on the first rung, one on the last), so lists come in every size; it makes far more records.
_leave: Worlds and records of these origins are another generator's.

post._: A post added to a world: written by someone of the world's club, wearing a look from the club's shop. `kind` and `ratio` are taken in turn; `title` and `caption` are templates ({world}, {zone} one of its zones, {club}); likes are a rung times `likesPer`; posts are dated back from `from`, `everyHours` apart.

event._: What is added to a world's calendar: templates taken in turn from a start that differs per world ({world}, {zone} one of its zones, {club}). `day` is days after `from`, moved by up to `shift` days per world; `time` the hour (UTC). The people going are a rung times `rsvpsPer`. A drop has a price (ETH) and a supply; a party a genre; a yearly event says when it comes back.
